Title: Sinusitis: Why Your Nose Won't Clear - 3 Habits Making It Worse

Description:
Thick yellow-green mucus and nonstop congestion? Swollen, blocked sinus openings trap fluid and fuel inflammation - and blowing your nose too hard, overusing decongestant spray, and dry indoor air all make that blockage worse. Learn the mechanism behind each one and the simple fixes that help your sinuses drain.

platforms.caption:
Nose won't stop running, and it's turned yellow-green? 🤧

Blowing too hard, decongestant spray past 3 days, and dry indoor air are three everyday habits that make sinus blockage worse. Blow gently, cap the spray at 3 days, and keep humidity around 40-50%.
